title: 10 Bass Facts in Under 30 Seconds
hook: Ten bass facts in under thirty seconds.
script: Ten bass facts in under thirty seconds. A largemouth's upper jaw reaches past its eye. A smallmouth's jaw never extends beyond the eye. Smallmouth wear vertical bars, not a side stripe. Bass belong to the sunfish family. Males fan out nests with their tails. Then the male guards the eggs alone. A swim bladder controls how a bass floats. Bigger largemouth will eat smaller bass. They feed hardest in low light. The record largemouth weighed twenty-two pounds, four ounces. Which one did you already know?
